current_activity: The 560th Volksgrenadier Division attacks toward the Our bridges at Ouren
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 8 p. 195: "The 560th Volks Grenadier Division (Generalmajor Rudolf Langhaeuser) was assigned two specific bridges as targets, one just north of Ouren, the other a stone arch a little to the south of the village"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "560th Volks Grenadier Division: Oberst R.
